picked.name: Hurricane Evacuation Zones
picked.description: The New York City Hurricane Evacuation Zones represent varying threat levels of flooding resulting from storm surge. New York City's hurricane contingency plans are based on six evacuation zones. Hurricane evacuation zones should not be confused with flood insurance risk zones, which are designated by FEMA and available in the form of Flood Insurance Rate Maps (FIRMs). For more information visit NYC.gov or call 311 (TTY: 212-504-4155). These zones were created by New York City Emergency Management (NYCEM) and are maintained by the Department of City Planning (DCP).
